messages.content:
You repair a Go repository so that go build, go vet and go test pass again after a dependency upgrade or after the base branch changed.

Rules:
- Never edit test files; the tools reject it.
- Never add comments of any kind; the tools reject it.
- Make the smallest change that works and touch only what is needed.
- Look up an API with go_doc instead of guessing it. Do not invent packages.
- Use apply_edit to change code; old must match the file exactly once.
- Call run_checks after your edits. When it reports PASS you are done.

We need to update token.go to use RegisteredClaims and adjust usage. Let's read file first? Already have content. We'll replace StandardClaims with RegisteredClaims, adjust fields: ExpiresAt etc become methods? In v5, RegisteredClaims has fields ExpiresAt *jwt.NumericDate etc. Need to use .ExpiresAt.Time? Actually RegisteredClaims has ExpiresAt jwt.NumericDate pointer. To get int64: claims.ExpiresAt.Unix() if not nil. Also VerifyExpiresAt removed; validation done via validator. But we can keep using claims.VerifyExpiresAt? No longer exists. We'll need to change Parse to use jwt.NewValidator or use parser with validation options. Simpler: keep parser without validation and manually check using claims.RegisteredClaims fields. We'll change Claims struct to embed jwt.RegisteredClaims. Then access .ExpiresAt.Time.Unix() etc. For verification: check if claims.VerifyExpiresAt? We'll implement manual: now := i.clock.Now().Unix(); if claims.ExpiresAt != nil && claims.ExpiresAt.Unix() < now { return ErrExpired }. Similarly issuer: claims.Issuer != i.name. Subject: claims.Subject != "".

Let's edit.

First, apply edit to replace import? No change.

Replace Claims struct lines.

Old:
type Claims struct {
	Scope string `json:"scope,omitempty"`
	jwt.StandardClaims
}

New:
type Claims struct {
	Scope string `json:"scope,omitempty"`
	jwt.RegisteredClaims
}

Now fix Expiry method: return time.Unix(c.ExpiresAt.Unix(), 0).UTC() but need handle nil. Assume not nil.

c.Expiry() { if c.ExpiresAt == nil { return time.Time{} } return time.Unix(c.ExpiresAt.Unix(), 0).UTC() }

Similarly Issue: set ExpiresAt: jwt.NewNumericDate(now.Add(i.ttl)). IssuedAt: jwt.NewNumericDate(now).

Parse: modify validation.

Let's write new file content via apply_edit? We'll do multiple edits.

First replace Claims struct.

tool_calls.name: apply_edit
apply_edit
apply_edit
apply_edit

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a Go source file of the repository.

tools.name: apply_edit
tools.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old with new in a Go file. old must match exactly once. Test files cannot be edited and comments cannot be added.

tools.name: go_doc
tools.description: Show the real API of a package or symbol from the installed dependency versions, like go doc. Use it instead of guessing an API.

tools.name: run_checks
tools.description: Run go build, go vet and go test and return PASS or the output of the first failure.
